body:
After running out of Ativan, in early Dec, I had to wait ~5wks for Singapore-manufactured Etizolam. I was drinking up to and beyond 5 drinks a day, and beginning to have shakes, cold sweats in the AM. When I started etizolam a week ago, I tapered my drinking to Zero on the 2nd day. Absolutely Zero DTs or GI problems!
Also helped my memory, slowed my thinking so I could accomplish ANY task, even those I did not want to do, with NO bad attitude whatsoever. Starting to taper off after a week, with Zero side effects.
Saved my life and my finances while living in the COVID paranoid & greedy US!
